_doc: Reserved-split manifest (EXP-0013 Phase 1.1 closeout). The layout range named "test" (ids 2000-2199) is reserved for locked held-out evaluations. tests/test_split_guard.py fails if any analysis/predictive_state/*.py file contains the string literal "test" and is not listed here. Listing a file records its historical exposure; it is not permission to add new uses. New exploratory scripts must use "train" or "dev". Hardening round: latency.py, _latency_exp0012.py, phase11_timing.py and analyze_state.py no longer contain the literal; they obtain their split from split_policy.py (default TRAIN). tests/test_split_guard.py executes latency.run and phase11_timing.record and checks the split actually passed to the simulator.

allowed_files.env.py: defines the split table (LAYOUT_RANGES) and EXP-0012 TEST_CONDS; no evaluation
allowed_files.lock.py: EXP-0012 preregistration text listing the layout ranges
allowed_files.run_eval.py: EXP-0012 locked TEST evaluation (preregistered gate G1; legitimate held-out scoring of the EXP-0012 models)
allowed_files.report.py: EXP-0012 report generator reading the TEST results
allowed_files.split_policy.py: the single place that names the reserved split and implements the opt-in (FLEXTERN_ALLOW_TEST_SPLIT=1); timing / trace / probe entrypoints default to TRAIN through it

historical_test_exposure.exp0012_task_scoring: run_eval.py / report.py: preregistered TEST evaluation of the EXP-0012 arms (before EXP-0013)
historical_test_exposure.exp0013_phase1_1_timing_traces: phase11_timing.record built E.BatchEnv(1, 'test', DIST) for 15 episodes per trigger (seeds 31..45; layout ids drawn from 2000-2199); used only to time inference; no success metric, tuning or code selection depends on it, but the Phase 1.1 latency and encoder-fraction figures were measured on them
historical_test_exposure.exp0013_la_task_scoring_on_test: none: no OccPick2D-LA environment was ever constructed on the test split
historical_test_exposure.entrypoint_defaults_before_hardening: latency.py, _latency_exp0012.py defaulted to TEST; phase11_timing.py defaulted to TRAIN since the closeout (1/2); analyze_state.py defaulted to TEST for its probe split. All now default to TRAIN; historical frozen results were not rewritten.
